beats.text: A Mars spacecraft was lost over a unit mix-up.
beats.note: Mars Climate Orbiter made its last contact nine months after launch.

beats.text: Thruster data was in pound-seconds, not newton-seconds.
beats.note: A ground software file called Small Forces produced English units. The navigation expected metric.

beats.context: The altitude the corrected figures put the orbiter at above Mars. It needed to stay above 80 km to survive. The plan had been 226 km.

beats.note: An hour before orbit insertion, estimates had fallen to as low as 110 km. A fifth correction manoeuvre was never carried out.

beats.text: The mission did not fail in space. It failed in a file format.
